title: Rounding twice

agents.task: Percent promos can leave fractional cents. Make calculateTotal in src/checkout.ts always return whole cents by rounding half up with Math.round. Add a test: a 25-cent item with a 50% promo totals 13 cents. You own src/checkout.ts and test/checkout.test.ts.

Add totalWithTax(items, promo, state) to src/tax.ts: the final taxed price, computed as applyTax(calculateTotal(items, promo), state) so the tax applies to the exact discounted amount and rounding happens once in applyTax. Add tests in test/total-with-tax.test.ts, including: a 25-cent item with a 50% promo in NY costs 13 cents. You own src/tax.ts and test/total-with-tax.test.ts.

notes: 12.5 cents: round once with 4% tax gives 13; round to 13 first and tax it gives 14. Correct merge: totalWithTax taxes applyDiscount(subtotal(items), promo), not the rounded calculateTotal.
